# odinex_locations (Data Source)

Lists all locations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "odinex_locations" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `ids` (List of String) IDs of all locations.
- `locations` (List of Object) All locations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--locations))
- `names` (List of String) Names of all locations.

<a id="nestedatt--locations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `locations`

Read-Only:

- `city` (String)
- `country` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `id` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `network_zone` (String)
- `status` (String)
